name: agentex-copilot
description: Agentic QA for GitHub Copilot — skip the manual grind. AgenTeX plans and runs tests (human-in-the-loop or fully autonomous) with structured evidence, durable run summaries, and a consolidated defect report, driving a real browser via Playwright. Test steps can call cataloged APIs and databases and ask a project's knowledge base for advisory context. Adapted from AgenTeX (github.com/MhmdElGazzar/agentex), a Claude Code plugin.
